records.title: Linear Recurrent Unit with Semantic Modulation for Image Super-Resolution
records.reason: Primary full text is an LRU/semantic-modulation model for single-image super-resolution. Its efficiency and memory results concern image restoration, not language-model inference; the linked LRU title alone does not establish a language-model contribution.

records.title: ARGUS: Production-Scale Tracing and Performance Diagnosis for over 10,000-GPU Clusters
records.reason: Primary full text describes ARGUS as a training-cluster tracing/diagnosis system and says inference-serving generalization is future work. Its contribution is observability, not an inference/serving improvement.

records.title: Spectral Query-Key Product Weight Steering for Training-Free VLM Hallucination Mitigation
records.reason: Primary text edits VLM query-key weights to reduce hallucination while leaving architecture and inference unchanged; it explicitly reports zero inference-cost change, making this a quality intervention rather than an efficiency improvement.
